using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.AudioToText;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors.AzureOpenAI;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors.AzureOpenAI.UnitTests.Extensions;

public class AzureOpenAIKernelBuilderExtensionsTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void AddAzureOpenAIAudioToText_WithClient_CallsGetServiceOnServiceProvider()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        var loggerFactoryMock = new Mock<ILoggerFactory>();
        services.AddSingleton(loggerFactoryMock.Object);

        var builder = Kernel.CreateBuilder();
        builder.Services.Add(services);

        var deploymentName = "test-deployment";
        var client = new Mock<AzureOpenAIClient>().Object;
        var modelId = "test-model";

        // Act
        builder.AddAzureOpenAIAudioToText(deploymentName, client, serviceId: "test-service", modelId: modelId);

        // Assert - Verify the service was registered by resolving it
        var serviceProvider = builder.Services.BuildServiceProvider();
        var audioService = serviceProvider.GetKeyedService<IAudioToTextService>("test-service") as AzureOpenAIAudioToTextService;

        Assert.NotNull(audioService);
        Assert.Equal(deploymentName, audioService!.DeploymentName);
        Assert.Equal(modelId, audioService.ModelId);
        Assert.Same(client, audioService.Client);

        // Verify GetService<ILoggerFactory>() was called during construction
        loggerFactoryMock.Verify(f => f.CreateLogger(It.IsAny<string>()), Times.AtLeastOnce);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AddAzureOpenAIAudioToText_WithoutClient_UsesGetRequiredServiceThenGetService()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        var loggerFactoryMock = new Mock<ILoggerFactory>();
        var clientMock = new Mock<AzureOpenAIClient>();
        services.AddSingleton(loggerFactoryMock.Object);
        services.AddSingleton(clientMock.Object);

        var builder = Kernel.CreateBuilder();
        builder.Services.Add(services);

        var deploymentName = "test-deployment";
        var modelId = "test-model";

        // Act
        builder.AddAzureOpenAIAudioToText(deploymentName, serviceId: "test-service", modelId: modelId);

        // Assert
        var serviceProvider = builder.Services.BuildServiceProvider();
        var audioService = serviceProvider.GetKeyedService<IAudioToTextService>("test-service") as AzureOpenAIAudioToTextService;

        Assert.NotNull(audioService);
        Assert.Equal(deploymentName, audioService!.DeploymentName);
        Assert.Equal(modelId, audioService.ModelId);
        Assert.Same(clientMock.Object, audioService.Client);

        // Verify both GetRequiredService<AzureOpenAIClient>() and GetService<ILoggerFactory>() were called
        loggerFactoryMock.Verify(f => f.CreateLogger(It.IsAny<string>()), Times.AtLeastOnce);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AddAzureOpenAIAudioToText_NullDeploymentName_ThrowsArgumentNullException()
    {
        // Arrange
        var builder = Kernel.CreateBuilder();

        // Act & Assert
        Assert.Throws<ArgumentNullException>(() => builder.AddAzureOpenAIAudioToText(null!));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AddAzureOpenAIAudioToText_EmptyDeploymentName_ThrowsArgumentException()
    {
        // Arrange
        var builder = Kernel.CreateBuilder();

        // Act & Assert
        Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => builder.AddAzureOpenAIAudioToText(""));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AddAzureOpenAIAudioToText_ValidParameters_ReturnsSameBuilder()
    {
        // Arrange
        var builder = Kernel.CreateBuilder();
        var originalBuilder = builder;

        // Act
        var result = builder.AddAzureOpenAIAudioToText("test-deployment");

        // Assert
        Assert.Same(originalBuilder, result);
    }
}
